import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { WatchlistStore } from '../app/watchlist-store';

describe('WatchlistStore', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    TestBed.configureTestingModule({});
  });

  // The store registers an effect() in its constructor, so it must be created
  // inside an injection context.
  function createStore(): WatchlistStore {
    return TestBed.runInInjectionContext(() => new WatchlistStore());
  }

  it('adds items whose seen flag starts false', () => {
    const store = createStore();
    store.add({
      id: 101,
      title: 'Dune',
      release_date: '2021-10-22',
      poster_path: '/dune.jpg',
      overview: 'A noble family becomes embroiled in a war.',
    });
    expect(store.count()).toBe(1);
    expect(store.items()[0].seen).toBe(false);
    expect(store.watchedCount()).toBe(0);
  });

  it('toggleWatched flips the seen flag and watchedCount follows', () => {
    const store = createStore();
    store.add({
      id: 102,
      title: 'Alien',
      release_date: '1979-05-25',
      poster_path: '/alien.jpg',
      overview: 'In space no one can hear you scream.',
    });

    store.toggleWatched(102);
    expect(store.items()[0].seen).toBe(true);
    expect(store.watchedCount()).toBe(1);

    store.toggleWatched(102);
    expect(store.items()[0].seen).toBe(false);
    expect(store.watchedCount()).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

import { computed, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { TmdbMovie, WatchItem } from './movie';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WatchlistStore {
    private readonly KEY = 'watchlist';

    /** Bumped on every persisted mutation so dependent computeds re-read storage. */
    private readonly version = signal(0);

    private load(): WatchItem[] {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(this.KEY);
            const parsed = raw === null ? [] : JSON.parse(raw);
            return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }

    private persist(items: WatchItem[]) {
        localStorage.setItem(this.KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
        this.version.update(v => v + 1);
    }

    private snapshot(): WatchItem[] {
        this.version(); // reactive dependency: re-read storage after every write
        return this.load();
    }

    items = computed(() => this.snapshot());
    count = computed(() => this.snapshot().length);
    watchedCount = computed(() => this.snapshot().filter(m => m.seen).length);

    add(movie: TmdbMovie) {
        const items = this.snapshot();
        if (items.some(m => m.id === movie.id)) return;
        this.persist([...items, { id: movie.id, title: movie.title, poster_path: movie.poster_path, release_date: movie.release_date, seen: false }]);
    }

    remove(id: number) {
        this.persist(this.snapshot().filter(m => m.id !== id));
    }

    toggleWatched(id: number) {
        this.persist(this.snapshot().map(m => m.id === id ? { ...m, seen: !m.seen } : m));
    }
}

import { computed, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { TmdbMovie, WatchItem } from './movie';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WatchlistStore {
    private readonly KEY = 'watchlist';

    /**
     * Bumped on every write-through to localStorage; acts as the reactive
     * dependency for all reads so persisted state is re-read after each mutation.
     */
    private readonly revision = signal(0);

    private load(): WatchItem[] {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(this.KEY);
            const parsed: unknown = raw === null ? [] : JSON.parse(raw);
            return Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as WatchItem[]) : [];
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }

    private persist(items: WatchItem[]) {
        localStorage.setItem(this.KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
        this.revision.update(rev => rev + 1);
    }

    /** Reads the persisted list; touches `revision` so callers track writes. */
    private snapshot(): WatchItem[] {
        this.revision();
        return this.load();
    }

    private readonly state = computed(() => this.snapshot());

    items = computed(() => this.state());
    count = computed(() => this.state().length);
    watchedCount = computed(() => this.state().filter(m => m.seen).length);

    add(movie: TmdbMovie) {
        const items = this.snapshot();
        if (items.some(m => m.id === movie.id)) {
            return;
        }
        this.persist([...items, {
            id: movie.id,
            title: movie.title,
            poster_path: movie.poster_path,
            release_date: movie.release_date,
            seen: false
        }]);
    }

    remove(id: number) {
        this.persist(this.snapshot().filter(m => m.id !== id));
    }

    toggleWatched(id: number) {
        this.persist(this.snapshot().map(m => m.id === id ? { ...m, seen: !m.seen } : m));
    }
}

import { computed, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { TmdbMovie, WatchItem } from './movie';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WatchlistStore {
    private readonly KEY = 'watchlist';

    // Bumped on every write-through so the computed views re-read storage.
    private readonly revision = signal(0);

    private load(): WatchItem[] {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(this.KEY);
            const parsed: unknown = raw === null ? [] : JSON.parse(raw);
            return Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as WatchItem[]) : [];
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }

    private persist(items: WatchItem[]) {
        localStorage.setItem(this.KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
        this.revision.update(rev => rev + 1);
    }

    private snapshot(): WatchItem[] {
        this.revision(); // tracked dependency: views re-read storage after each write
        return this.load();
    }

    items = computed(() => this.snapshot());
    count = computed(() => this.items().length);
    watchedCount = computed(() => this.items().filter(m => m.seen).length);

    add(movie: TmdbMovie) {
        const items = this.snapshot();
        if (items.some(m => m.id === movie.id)) {
            return;
        }
        this.persist([...items, {
            id: movie.id,
            title: movie.title,
            poster_path: movie.poster_path,
            release_date: movie.release_date,
            seen: false
        }]);
    }

    remove(id: number) {
        this.persist(this.snapshot().filter(m => m.id !== id));
    }

    toggleWatched(id: number) {
        this.persist(this.snapshot().map(m => m.id === id ? { ...m, seen: !m.seen } : m));
    }
}
```

## Diagnosis

The store hydrates **eagerly at construction** (`signal(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? '[]'))`). In the failing test, the instance is created in `beforeEach` (while storage is empty), then `localStorage` is seeded, then `TestBed.inject(WatchlistStore)` returns that **same cached instance** — its signal still holds `[]`, so `watchedCount()` is 0. Additionally, persistence relies solely on a constructor `effect()`, which never flushes in a plain service test.

## Fix

Make `localStorage` the source of truth, read **lazily** through computeds (keyed to a revision signal), and **write through eagerly** inside `add()`/`remove()`/`toggleWatched()`:

- `load()` parses the `seen`-keyed payload as-is — no filtering, no `watched` fallback, `seen` preserved exactly (only non-array/corrupt payloads are ignored).
- `watchedCount()` counts exactly `m.seen === true`.
- Reads are lazy, so the seeded data is visible on first read even on the already-constructed instance; the revision bump keeps `items`/`count`/`watchedCount` reactive after each eager write (which also makes a second store, constructed later, see persisted state immediately — no reliance on the never-flushing constructor effect, which is removed along with the now-unneeded injection-context requirement).

Public API unchanged: `items`, `count`, `watchedCount`, `add`, `remove`, `toggleWatched`. No existing test is touched; I appended two tests that pin the write-through and lazy-read behavior.
